source.name: Warosu Database Backup 2023-03-15
source.short-desc: Database backup of warosu.org on 2023-03-15 in mysqldump (SQL statements) format
source.capture: 12 per-board mysqldumps as .sql.zst. The IA item lists them loose; an all-files zip of the same content also exists, so prepare handles either starting point.

prepare.name: unpack the zip, if the item was fetched in that form
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && if [ -z "$(ls out/*.sql 2>/dev/null)" ] && ! ls extracted/*.sql.zst extracted/*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.sql.zst' -not -path './extracted/*' -print -quit)" ]; then z=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.zip' -print -quit); [ -n "$z" ] && 7z x -aos -o./extracted "$z"; fi; true

prepare.name: decompress the zstd per-board dumps
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && find . -name '*.sql.zst' -not -path './out/*' | while read -r f; do b=$(basename "${f%.zst}"); [ -e "extracted/$b" ] || [ -e "out/$b" ] || unzstd -q -o "extracted/$b" "$f"; done

prepare.name: stage the .sql dumps for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && find extracted -name '*.sql' -exec sh -c 'cp -al "$1" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$1" out/' _ {} ';'
